prompts.title: High-Converting Tech Video Script & Hook Generator
prompts.promptText: Act as an expert YouTube Scriptwriter. Write a high-retention 8-minute script about the latest AI video tools. Start with an ultra-engaging 15-second visual hook targeting aspiring content creators, followed by a story-driven introduction, 3 actionable main value pillars, and a compelling call-to-action to subscribe to Technical Bilal Jahangir. Keep the tone friendly, enthusiastic, and fast-paced.
